specialties.name: Berserker
specialties.intent: You gave up your guard and your grip on your gear for the biggest swing on the field, and you cannot afford to miss twice.
specialties.source: Hell-TCG Warrior/Beserker (settled; spelling corrected, keeps the name in the collision with Barbarian/Berserker)

specialties.name: Shieldbearer
specialties.intent: You are the piece of the line that does not move, and the enemy has to solve you before they solve anyone else.

specialties.name: Leader
specialties.intent: You fight with your eyes up: your own numbers are good, and everyone standing near you gets better ones.

specialties.name: Reaver
specialties.intent: Everyone on this hex is bleeding, including you; the fight is a race and you started with more blood to spend.
specialties.source: Hell-TCG Barbarian/Reaver | 2026-08-17: a startOfBattle trigger with an ENEMY radius fires on nobody — the two sides do not deploy near each other. Rebuilt as an aura, which is checked continuously. | 2026-08-17 trim: three stats, no negatives, one ability. Dropped stats: armor -1; dodge -5. Parked abilities: aura: AURA radius 2 — an enemy that ends its Activation inside gains 1 Bleed || onKill: remove all Bleed from yourself. | 2026-08-17: third stat surge +1 — the fight is a race and you take more swings in it.

specialties.name: Warchief
specialties.intent: You drive the warband forward by fear and by blood — everyone hits harder, everyone pays for it, and nobody argues.

triggers.effect: every ally within 3 hexes gains +1 Strength for the rest of the Battle

specialties.source: Hell-TCG Barbarian/Warchief | 2026-08-17 trim: three stats, no negatives, one ability. Dropped stats: dodge -5. Parked abilities: onKill: every ally within 3 hexes loses 1 Weak.

specialties.name: Bloodrage
specialties.intent: Every corpse makes the next swing worse for someone; you are strongest in the last third of a battle that has gone badly.

triggers.effect: gain +1 Strength and +2 Crit for the rest of the Battle, stacking

specialties.source: Hell-TCG Barbarian/Berserker (renamed — collided with Warrior/Beserker; name taken from its own power Blood Rage) | 2026-08-17 trim: three stats, no negatives, one ability. Dropped stats: health -2; resist -1. Parked abilities: onAllyDeath: regain 1 Stamina and gain +5 Accuracy for the rest of the Battle. | 2026-08-17: third stat surge +1 — strongest in the last third of a battle — Surge is the stat that gets you there.

specialties.name: Champion
specialties.intent: You pick one enemy out of the mess and make the whole battle about the two of you.

triggers.effect: remove 5 Weak from yourself and heal 3

specialties.source: Hell-TCG Knight/Champion | 2026-08-17 trim: three stats, no negatives, one ability. Dropped stats: dodge -5; health +2. | 2026-08-17: my trim ranked stats by rarity and dropped a class-PRIMARY stat to keep a rarer one. Restored; the cheapest stat on’s ladder (Accuracy, then Dodge) was dropped instead.

specialties.name: Guardian
specialties.intent: You give your own protection away and stand in the doorway; the enemy can go through you or go nowhere.

triggers.effect: you lose 1 Armor for the rest of the Battle; every ally within 3 hexes gains +1 Armor for the rest of the Battle

specialties.source: Hell-TCG Knight/Guardian | 2026-08-17 trim: three stats, no negatives, one ability. Dropped stats: movement -1. Parked abilities: onAllyDamaged: if the ally is adjacent to you, reduce that damage by 1. | 2026-08-17: third stat luck +5 — hard to crit is what standing in a doorway actually means.

specialties.name: Crusader
specialties.intent: Every blow you land burns; you are what gets sent at the things that should not exist.

triggers.effect: your melee attacks apply 1 Burn, or 2 Burn against undead, demon or horror

specialties.source: Hell-TCG Knight/Crusader | 2026-08-17 trim: three stats, no negatives, one ability. Dropped stats: dodge -5; health +2. | 2026-08-17: my trim ranked stats by rarity and dropped a class-PRIMARY stat to keep a rarer one. Restored; the cheapest stat on’s ladder (Accuracy, then Dodge) was dropped instead.

powers.name: Fast Fury
powers.description: Take 2 true damage and gain +1 Strength for the rest of the Battle; the bonus stacks each time you use it.
powers.source: Hell-TCG name reused (Warrior/Beserker, Fast Fury) | 2026-08-17: "difficult terrain" is not a thing in HoBaT — there are hexes that cost extra Movement. Reworded.

powers.name: Unbreakable
powers.description: Lose 3 Movement for the rest of the Battle and gain Protection equal to 4 + three times your Armor. Using it IS the choice — there is no second option to weigh, only the question of whether this is the Turn.
powers.source: Hell-TCG name reused (badge power, Unbreakable) | 2026-08-17: Protection has no duration — it decays 1 a Turn and by the damage it absorbs. Duration clause removed. | 2026-08-17: "difficult terrain" is not a thing in HoBaT — there are hexes that cost extra Movement. Reworded. | 2026-08-17 quality pass: was a flat, decisionless grant. Rebuilt as a cost/benefit — the big version is bought with 2 Movement for the Battle. | 2026-08-20: there is no in-power choice mechanic, so the two-option version is gone — choosing to activate it is the choice. Warmup 6, cooldown 6, 1 stamina, -3 Movement, Protection 4 + 3x Armor.
powers.intent: It arrives late, it costs you the ability to be anywhere else, and on a Warrior in real armour it is the largest single number in the game.

powers.name: Titan's Inspiration
powers.description: Melee attack at +1 Strength. If it hits, every ally within 3 hexes gains +1 Strength for the rest of the Battle.
powers.source: Hell-TCG name reused (Warrior/Warleader, Titan's Strength) | 2026-08-17: renamed from Titan's Strength; the buff is +1 Strength, not +5 Accuracy; 1 stam/CD2 -> 2 stam/CD4. | 2026-08-17: "difficult terrain" is not a thing in HoBaT — there are hexes that cost extra Movement. Reworded.

powers.name: Rend
powers.description: Until the end of your next Turn, your attacks apply 3 Bleed on hit. Bleed is never reduced by Resist.
powers.source: Hell-TCG name reused (Barbarian/Reaver, Rend) | 2026-08-17: was an attack in its own right, so it competed with the weapon in your hands and lost the moment you found a good one. Rebuilt as a next-attack modifier. | 2026-08-17: "difficult terrain" is not a thing in HoBaT — there are hexes that cost extra Movement. Reworded. | 2026-08-20: "your next MELEE attack" asks the engine to hold a modifier against one future attack and to check its form when it happens. Neither is tracked. Rewritten as a duration: until the end of your next Turn your attacks apply 3 Bleed. Also dropped the "which Resist does not stop" clause — Resist never stops Bleed, so the sentence was restating a rule.
powers.intent: Four Bleed that nothing mitigates, hung on whatever you swing for the next Turn rather than on one nominated swing.

powers.name: Red Harvest
powers.description: Deal Strength physical damage to every enemy adjacent to you and give each 1 Bleed; as an area effect it cannot crit.
powers.source: Hell-TCG name reused (Barbarian/Reaver, Cleave — row targeting rebuilt as adjacency) | 2026-08-17: "difficult terrain" is not a thing in HoBaT — there are hexes that cost extra Movement. Reworded. | 2026-08-20: disambiguate. attack.halberd.cleave already owns "Cleave" — an attack and a power sharing a name puts two different things on one hero sheet under one word.

powers.name: Gore
powers.description: Make two melee attacks against the same enemy at -10 Accuracy each; you gain 2 Bleed whether or not they land.
powers.source: Hell-TCG name reused (Barbarian/Reaver, Gore) | 2026-08-17: "difficult terrain" is not a thing in HoBaT — there are hexes that cost extra Movement. Reworded.

powers.name: Blood Price
powers.description: Take 4 true damage to immediately regain 2 Stamina.
powers.source: new | 2026-08-17: "difficult terrain" is not a thing in HoBaT — there are hexes that cost extra Movement. Reworded. | 2026-08-20: the "you may not use this while Bleed would kill you this Turn" restriction is cut — it needed a lethality check nothing else runs, and it is not a decision worth protecting the player from. Cooldown dropped to 1: usable every other Turn.
powers.intent: A stamina engine with a bill. Every other Turn, if you can stand the bleeding.

powers.name: War Cry
powers.description: Apply 2 Weak to every enemy within 3 hexes; every ally within 3 hexes gains +1 Strength for the rest of the Battle.
powers.source: Hell-TCG name reused (Barbarian/Warchief, War Cry) | 2026-08-17: "difficult terrain" is not a thing in HoBaT — there are hexes that cost extra Movement. Reworded.

powers.name: Intimidate
powers.description: Every enemy within 4 hexes takes -10 Accuracy for the rest of the Battle and gains 1 Slow.
powers.source: Hell-TCG name reused (Barbarian/Warchief, Intimidate — mass Stun rebuilt as an Accuracy and Movement debuff) | 2026-08-17: "difficult terrain" is not a thing in HoBaT — there are hexes that cost extra Movement. Reworded. | 2026-08-20: "clean up that movement stuff." A one-Turn Movement loss is now the Slow status — apply N Slow. Fourteen entries said this two different ways and every one of them needed the engine to remember whose next Turn it was. Amount unchanged.

powers.name: Blood Oath
powers.description: You and every ally within 3 hexes gain +2 Strength for the rest of the Battle and immediately take 3 true damage.
powers.source: Hell-TCG mechanic reused, renamed (Barbarian/Warchief, Blood Rage) | 2026-08-17: "difficult terrain" is not a thing in HoBaT — there are hexes that cost extra Movement. Reworded.

powers.name: Lead From Front
powers.description: Move up to 3 hexes and make a melee attack at +1 Strength. Every ally adjacent to you afterwards gains +1 Surge for the rest of the Battle.
powers.source: Hell-TCG name reused (Barbarian/Warchief, Lead from Front — roster-size effect cut) | 2026-08-17: "difficult terrain" is not a thing in HoBaT — there are hexes that cost extra Movement. Reworded. | 2026-08-17 quality pass: the ally payoff was +5 Accuracy, which on a veteran is +1.25 Crit. Changed to +1 Surge — a Warchief should give people more turns.

powers.name: Frenzy
powers.description: Make three melee attacks at -10 Accuracy each, spread across as many different enemies in reach as possible.
powers.source: Hell-TCG name reused (Barbarian, Frenzy — random targeting rebuilt as reach-limited spread) | 2026-08-17: "difficult terrain" is not a thing in HoBaT — there are hexes that cost extra Movement. Reworded.

powers.name: Bloodlust
powers.description: Stance: gain +3 Strength and -10 Accuracy for the rest of the Battle, and take 1 true damage at the start of each of your Turns.
powers.source: Hell-TCG name reused (Barbarian, Bloodlust) | 2026-08-17: "difficult terrain" is not a thing in HoBaT — there are hexes that cost extra Movement. Reworded.

powers.name: Unstoppable
powers.description: remove 5 Stun and 5 Weak from yourself and heal 4.
powers.source: Hell-TCG name reused (Barbarian, Unstoppable) | 2026-08-17: "difficult terrain" is not a thing in HoBaT — there are hexes that cost extra Movement. Reworded. | 2026-08-20: "ignore the next Stun applied to you this Battle" is cut — there is no ignoring a status. Immunity N is the mechanic for that, and it belongs on items rather than bolted onto a cleanse.

powers.name: Death Feeds the Rage
powers.description: Make a melee attack at +5 Accuracy. On kill, heal 4 and gain +1 Strength for the rest of the Battle.
powers.source: new | 2026-08-17: "difficult terrain" is not a thing in HoBaT — there are hexes that cost extra Movement. Reworded. | 2026-08-20: a "usable only if" gate on your own or the target's state is not a thing — nothing reads a Health threshold or an event history to decide whether a power is legal. "usable only on a Turn in which any unit within 4 hexes died" cut — an event-history gate. The payoff moved onto the kill itself.

powers.name: Challenge
powers.description: For the rest of the Battle you have +2 Strength and +10 Accuracy, and -5 Dodge.
powers.source: Hell-TCG name reused (Knight/Champion, Challenge — flat stat dump rebuilt as a single-target commitment) | 2026-08-17: "difficult terrain" is not a thing in HoBaT — there are hexes that cost extra Movement. Reworded. | 2026-08-20: "name one enemy" was the mark system again — a persistent per-target designation, which was cut with item.rune-hunters-mark and the whole Contractbound line. Rebuilt without a nominated target. | 2026-08-20 sweep: "-5 Accuracy against anything you have not attacked this Turn" was the mark system a third time — a per-target memory of who you have swung at. Nothing counts occurrences and nothing remembers a target. The cost is now a flat -5 Dodge, and the power targets self, because there is no longer anyone to point at.

powers.name: Righteous Blow
powers.description: Until the end of your next Turn, your attacks gain +5 Crit and add your Armor to their damage, and heal you 2 on a hit.
powers.source: Hell-TCG name reused (Knight, Righteous Blow) | 2026-08-17: "difficult terrain" is not a thing in HoBaT — there are hexes that cost extra Movement. Reworded. | 2026-08-17 design pass: rebuilt a power that was just an attack into a next-attack Armor blend, so it scales with every weapon and every breastplate you will ever find. | 2026-08-20: "your next <form> attack" is gone. Nothing tracks which attack is next or what form it is. Rewritten as a duration: until the end of your next Turn, your attacks carry it. The form qualifier is dropped with it.

powers.name: Heroic Charge
powers.description: Move up to your Movement in a straight line and make a melee attack at +2 Strength.
powers.source: Hell-TCG name reused (badge power, Heroic Charge — row damage and extra Action cut) | 2026-08-17: "difficult terrain" is not a thing in HoBaT — there are hexes that cost extra Movement. Reworded. | 2026-08-20: "if it kills" written inside a description IS onKill, spelled out the long way. Moved onto the hook, which is where the engine already looks. The condition category "the attack killed" disappears with it — there was never a condition, only a trigger written as prose.

powers.name: Prove Yourself
powers.description: Free. Until the end of your next Turn, you have: on kill, gain +2 Strength, +2 Precision and +10 Crit for the rest of the Battle.
powers.source: Hell-TCG name reused (badge power, Prove Yourself) | 2026-08-17: "difficult terrain" is not a thing in HoBaT — there are hexes that cost extra Movement. Reworded. | 2026-08-20: a "usable only if" gate on your own or the target's state is not a thing — nothing reads a Health threshold or an event history to decide whether a power is legal. "usable only at or below half Health" cut. It is now a free window that pays out if you kill inside it — the same idea without asking the engine how hurt you are.
powers.intent: A window, not a condition. Open it and then go and earn something inside it.

powers.name: Iron Wall
powers.description: Stance: gain +2 Armor and -2 Movement for the rest of the Battle.
powers.source: Hell-TCG name reused (Knight/Guardian, Iron Wall) | 2026-08-17: "difficult terrain" is not a thing in HoBaT — there are hexes that cost extra Movement. Reworded.

powers.name: Hold the Line
powers.description: Stance: for the rest of the Battle, your attacks of opportunity gain +30 Accuracy and +4 damage.
powers.source: Hell-TCG name reused (Priest/War Priest, Hold the Line — repurposed to the ally-facing Guardian) | 2026-08-17: "difficult terrain" is not a thing in HoBaT — there are hexes that cost extra Movement. Reworded. | 2026-08-17 quality pass: carried a condition the engine cannot check ('while you do not move') around a flat ally buff. Rebuilt on zones of control, which is what holding a line means and which one row in the entire set currently uses. | 2026-08-17: every unit has Sidestep, so a zone of control cannot pin anything — it taxes the SECOND hex of a withdrawal, not the first. Reworded to say what it actually does. | 2026-08-20: the zone-of-control aura is cut — taxing movement out of a hex is a subsystem, and it was already cut from item.chains-of-the-damned for the same reason. Rebuilt on attacks of opportunity, which exist.
powers.intent: You do not stop them leaving. You make leaving the most expensive thing they do all fight.

powers.name: Stalwart
powers.description: Free. Take 3 true damage, remove 1 Stun from yourself, and gain +2 Resist for the rest of the Battle.
powers.source: Hell-TCG name reused (Knight/Guardian, Stalwart — Resolute was CUT, rebuilt as Resist plus a Stun strip) | 2026-08-17: "difficult terrain" is not a thing in HoBaT — there are hexes that cost extra Movement. Reworded. | 2026-08-17 quality pass: a free power handing out a permanent +2 Resist, top of the stat ladder, with no decision in it. The Resist now costs 3 true damage and is bought once. | 2026-08-20: reworded the opening. "Free" here means it does not consume your primary action — it never meant costless, and on an item that also charges stamina the old wording read as though it did. | 2026-08-20: standardised to "Free." A trinket that does not use your action is a power and appears in the power list, so it uses the same word powers use. The stamina cost is a field, not prose. | 2026-08-20: the "you may take 3 true damage to" choice is cut — there is no in-power choice mechanic. The damage is simply the cost. The "does not stack with itself" clause went with it; there is no stacking limit either.
powers.intent: The Stun comes off and the Resist goes on, and both of them cost blood.

powers.name: No Way Past
powers.description: For the rest of the Battle, any enemy that begins its Turn adjacent to you takes -15 Accuracy against every target except you.
powers.source: new | 2026-08-17: "difficult terrain" is not a thing in HoBaT — there are hexes that cost extra Movement. Reworded.

powers.name: Holy Charge
powers.description: Move up to 4 hexes and make a melee attack at +2 Strength dealing true damage. It provokes nothing — you are not leaving the line, you are extending it.
powers.source: Hell-TCG name reused (Knight, Holy Charge) | 2026-08-17: "difficult terrain" is not a thing in HoBaT — there are hexes that cost extra Movement. Reworded. | 2026-08-17 quality pass: kept the true damage, added provocation immunity so it is a charge rather than a longer step.

powers.name: Flaming Smite
powers.description: Until the end of your next Turn, your attacks apply 3 Burn on hit, or 5 Burn against undead, demon or horror.
powers.source: Hell-TCG name reused (Templar/Holy Champion, Flaming Smite) | 2026-08-17: was an attack in its own right, so it competed with the weapon in your hands and lost the moment you found a good one. Rebuilt as a next-attack modifier. | 2026-08-17: "difficult terrain" is not a thing in HoBaT — there are hexes that cost extra Movement. Reworded. | 2026-08-20: "your next <form> attack" is gone. Nothing tracks which attack is next or what form it is. Rewritten as a duration: until the end of your next Turn, your attacks carry it. The form qualifier is dropped with it.

powers.name: Oathbound
powers.description: Stance: for the rest of the Battle gain +2 Strength and +2 Resist against undead, demon and horror, and -5 Accuracy against everything else.
powers.source: Hell-TCG name reused (Knight, Oathbound — Faith and Spirit gain cut) | 2026-08-17: "difficult terrain" is not a thing in HoBaT — there are hexes that cost extra Movement. Reworded.

powers.name: Holy Fire
powers.description: Every enemy within 2 hexes gains 3 Burn, or 5 Burn if undead, demon or horror; as an area effect it cannot crit and each tick is reduced by Resist.
powers.source: Hell-TCG name reused (Inquisitor, Holy Fire) | 2026-08-17: "difficult terrain" is not a thing in HoBaT — there are hexes that cost extra Movement. Reworded.

powers.name: Bramble Guard
powers.description: Stance: gain Thorns 4 for the rest of the Battle. Anything that damages you takes 4 true damage, at any range — the archer on the ridge included.
powers.intent: You stop being something they can attack for free.
powers.source: new 2026-08-20: wants Thorns in class powers, and the Shieldbearer is where being hit is the plan.
